operations.description: Convert a document into layout-aware structured JSON/markdown (synchronous).

operations.name: parse_async
operations.description: Enqueue a parse job and return a job_id immediately (asynchronous).

operations.name: extract
operations.description: Pull specific structured fields from a document using a JSON schema (synchronous).

operations.name: extract_async
operations.description: Asynchronous schema-based field extraction; returns a job_id.

operations.name: split
operations.description: Divide a multi-document file into labeled sections (synchronous).

operations.name: split_async
operations.description: Asynchronous document splitting; returns a job_id.

operations.name: classify
operations.description: Categorize a document into one of a provided set of document types/labels.

operations.name: edit
operations.description: Programmatically modify a PDF/DOCX - fill forms, write field values, redact (synchronous).

operations.name: edit_async
operations.description: Asynchronous document editing / form write-back; returns a job_id.

operations.name: pipeline
operations.description: Run a composed multi-step pipeline (split -> parse -> extract) in one call (synchronous).

operations.name: pipeline_async
operations.description: Asynchronous pipeline execution; returns a job_id.

operations.name: get_job

operations.name: list_jobs
operations.description: List async jobs for the account with cursor-based pagination.

operations.name: cancel_job

operations.name: get_version
